trigger.Name: StartBackgroundCuts
trigger.script:
IMPULSES = GET_GLOBAL_OBJECT "IMPULSES" IMPULSES:UnbindKey1("GS_CINEMATIC", "KEY_ESCAPE", "IM_CINEMATIC_SKIP")
SetGameTime(15, 0) SetWeather(0)
CreateNewDummyObject("background_forest", "forest_bg", -1, -1, CVector(659.046, 340.000, 842.639), Quaternion(0.0000, -0.1327, 0.0000, 0.9912), 0) CreateNewSgNodeObject("logo_efa", "logo", -1, -1, CVector(659.057, 342.000, 850.364), Quaternion(0, 1, 0, 0), 1)
Fly("start_bg"..random(2), CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 1.5, 0, 0, 0) Fly("start_bg3", CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0) StartCinematic()
TActivate("BackgroundChangeSkin") TActivate("StartBackgroundCuts_Message") TActivate("StartBackgroundCuts_End")
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: BackgroundChangeSkin
trigger.script: local bg = GetEntityByName("forest_bg") if bg then local skin = bg:GetSkin() if skin == 4 then bg:SetSkin(0) else bg:SetSkin(skin + 1) end else trigger:Deactivate() end

trigger.Name: StartBackgroundCuts_Message
trigger.script: local b = SpawnMessageBox("90004") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: StartBackgroundCuts_End
trigger.script:
TDeactivate("StartBackgroundCuts_Message")
CreateNewDummyObject("dweller_player", "bear", -1, -1, CVector(658.000, 338.000, 845.500), Quaternion(0.0000, 0.9455, 0.0000, 0.3256)) CreateNewDummyObject("dweller_brodyaga", "usec", -1, -1, CVector(660.000, 338.000, 845.500), Quaternion(0.0000, -0.9455, 0.0000, 0.3256)) CreateEffectInsertedInRemove("ET_PS_DRONE", CVector(658.000, 338.000, 845.500), Quaternion(0, 0, 0, 1), true) CreateEffectInsertedInRemove("ET_PS_DRONE", CVector(660.000, 338.000, 845.500), Quaternion(0, 0, 0, 1), true)
Fly("start_bg3", CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 2, 0, 0, 0) StartCinematic()
TActivate("SelectFractionsCuts_End") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: SelectFractionsCuts_End
trigger.script: StartConversation("SelectFractions_NPC") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: SelectBEAR
trigger.script:
local usec = GetEntityByName("usec") if usec then usec:SetPosition(CVector(0, 0, 0)) end
local moverBear = GetEntityByName("MoverBEAR") if moverBear then moverBear:Remove() end
local moverUsec = GetEntityByName("MoverUSEC") if moverUsec then moverUsec:Remove() end
local moverId = CreateNewObject { prototypeName = "cinematicMover", objName = "MoverBEAR" } local mover = GetEntityByID( moverId ) local controlledObj = GetEntityByName("bear") if controlledObj then controlledObj:SetPosition(CVector(658.000, 338.000, 845.500)) controlledObj:SetRotation(Quaternion(0.0000, 0.9455, 0.0000, 0.3256)) mover:SetObjAndPath(controlledObj:GetId(), "move_bear", 1.25) end
Fly("start_bg3", CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 2, 0, 0, 0) StartCinematic()
TActivate("SelectBEAR_End") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: SelectBEAR_End
trigger.script: StartConversation("SelectBEAR_NPC") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: SelectUSEC

local usec = GetEntityByName("bear") if usec then usec:SetPosition(CVector(0, 0, 0)) end
local moverBear = GetEntityByName("MoverBEAR") if moverBear then moverBear:Remove() end
local moverUsec = GetEntityByName("MoverUSEC") if moverUsec then moverUsec:Remove() end
local moverId = CreateNewObject { prototypeName = "cinematicMover", objName = "MoverUSEC" } local mover = GetEntityByID( moverId ) local controlledObj = GetEntityByName("usec") if controlledObj then controlledObj:SetPosition(CVector(660.000, 338.000, 845.500)) controlledObj:SetRotation(Quaternion(0.0000, -0.9455, 0.0000, 0.3256)) mover:SetObjAndPath(controlledObj:GetId(), "move_usec", 1.25) end
Fly("start_bg3", CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 2, 0, 0, 0) StartCinematic()
TActivate("SelectUSEC_End") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.script: StartConversation("SelectUSEC_NPC") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: EndSelectFractionsCuts
trigger.script: Fly("start_bg3", CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0) StartCinematic() TActivate("EndSelectFractionsCuts_End") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: EndSelectFractionsCuts_End
trigger.script:
IMPULSES = GET_GLOBAL_OBJECT "IMPULSES" IMPULSES:BindKey1("GS_CINEMATIC", "KEY_ESCAPE", "IM_CINEMATIC_SKIP")
TDeactivate("BackgroundChangeSkin")
local objRemove = {"bear", "usec", "MoverBEAR", "MoverUSEC", "forest_bg", "logo"} for i = 1, 6 do local r = GetEntityByName(objRemove[i]) if r then r:Remove() end end
local player = getObj("Player1") if player then if GetVar("SelectBelong").AsString == "BEAR" then player:SetPropertyById("44", "mask_hero") else player:SetPropertyById("44", "brodyaga_mask") end end
TActivate("StartFadeEffect") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: StartFadeEffect
trigger.script:
g_ObjCont:SetGameTime( 10, 0, 21, 5, 2023 ) SetRadarUpgrade(1) SetWeather(0) SetVar("Weather", 0) SetVar("SpeedWind", random(4, 10)) SetVar("GameTimeHour", "DAY")
Fly("start_game", CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 0.1, 0, 1) StartCinematic() UpdateCinematic(1)
AddCinematicMessage(77773, 0)
TActivate("trCreatePlayerStartVehicle") TActivate("StartFadeEffect_End") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: StartFadeEffect_End
trigger.script:
SetCameraBehindPlayerVehicle() map()
TActivate("Message") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: trCreatePlayerStartVehicle
trigger.script:
AddPlayerVehicle("Bug01ForStart")
local vehPlayer = GetPlayerVehicle() if vehPlayer then vehPlayer:SetGamePositionOnGround(CVector(893.077, 255.493, 987.899)) vehPlayer:SetRotation(Quaternion(-0.009, -0.005, -0.000, 1.000)) end
AddItemsToPlayerRepository("machinery_use", 1) AddItemsToPlayerRepository("ammo_chest_machinegun", 1) trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutEntersToTunnel
trigger.script:
SaveAllToleranceStatus(RS_NEUTRAL)
Fly("tunel_cam01", CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 6, 1, 1) StartCinematic()
TActivate("TunelOpenGate") TActivate("cutEntersToTunnel_End") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: TunelOpenGate
trigger.script: local g = GetEntityByName("tunel_gate") if g then g:SetNodeAction(AT_RESERVED4) end CreateNewSgNodeObject("ET_S_DUNGEON_OPEN_GATE", "sound_gate1", -1, -1, CVector(815, 259, 1054), Quaternion(0, 0, 0, 0), 0) TActivate("TunelOpenGate_SoundEnd") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: TunelOpenGate_SoundEnd
trigger.script: local s = GetEntityByName("sound_gate1") if s then s:Remove() end CreateNewSgNodeObject("ET_S_DUNGEON_OPEN_GATE_END", "sound_gate2", -1, -1, CVector(815, 259, 1054), Quaternion(0, 0, 0, 0), 0) trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutEntersToTunnel_End
trigger.script:
local g = GetEntityByName("tunel_gate") if g then g:SetNodeAction(AT_STAND2) end
for i=1,2 do local s = GetEntityByName("sound_gate"..i) if s then s:Remove() end end
TDeactivate("TunelOpenGate") TDeactivate("TunelOpenGate_SoundEnd")
TActivate("cutEntersToTunnel_Fade") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutEntersToTunnel_Fade
trigger.script:
Fly("tunel_cam01", CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 0.1, 0, 1) StartCinematic()
AddCinematicMessage(77773, 0)
CreateNewSgNodeObject("ET_S_DUNGEON_ENTERS", "fx", -1, -1, GetPlayerVehicle():GetPosition(), Quaternion(0, 0, 0, 0), 0)
TActivate("cutEntersToTunnel_FadeEnd") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutEntersToTunnel_FadeEnd
trigger.script:
RestoreAllToleranceStatus()
local fx = GetEntityByName("fx") if fx then fx:Remove() end
PassToMap("r0m1", "FromR0M0", -1, 1) trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutCredits
trigger.script:
IMPULSES = GET_GLOBAL_OBJECT "IMPULSES" IMPULSES:UnbindKey1("GS_CINEMATIC", "KEY_SPACE", "IM_CINEMATIC_SKIP_MSG")
SaveAllToleranceStatus(RS_NEUTRAL)
SetWeather(0) SetGameTime(20,0)
PlayCustomMusic("Credits01")
if GetVar("SelectBelong").AsString == "BEAR" then CreateHuman("Human_player_slow", 1100, CVector(1045.535, 255.641, 1525.996), "HumanPlayer") else CreateHuman("Human_brodyaga_slow", 1100, CVector(1045.535, 255.641, 1525.996), "HumanPlayer") end
local hum = GetEntityByName("HumanPlayer") local humID = hum:GetId()
Fly("credits_cam01", CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 21.9, 1, 0) FlyLinked("credits_cam_keqing01", humID, 40.57, 0, 0, nil) FlyLinked("credits_cam_player01_1", humID, 0.64, 0, 0, nil) FlyLinked("credits_cam_player01_2", humID, 0.57, 0, 0, nil) FlyLinked("credits_cam_player01_3", humID, 0.58, 0, 0, nil) FlyLinked("credits_cam_player02", humID, 29.94, 0, 0, nil) FlyLinked("credits_cam_player02_1", humID, 0.74, 0, 0, nil) FlyLinked("credits_cam_player02_2", humID, 0.6, 0, 0, nil) FlyLinked("credits_cam_keqing02_3", humID, 1.25, 0, 0, nil) FlyLinked("credits_cam_keqing02_4", humID, 1.6, 0, 0, nil) FlyLinked("credits_cam_player02", humID, 5.1, 0, 0, nil) Fly("credits_cam03", CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 4.45, 0, 0) Fly("start_game", CINEMATIC_NO_AIM, 0, 2, 0, 1) StartCinematic()
AddCinematicMessage(1, 0)
TActivate("cutCreditsFadeIn") TActivate("cutCreditsCamPlayer01") TActivate("cutCreditsCamPlayer02") TActivate("cutCreditsCam_start_game") TActivate("cutCreditsEnd")
local vehPlayer = GetPlayerVehicle() if vehPlayer then vehPlayer:SetThrottle(0) vehPlayer:SetCustomLinearVelocity(0) end
local hum = GetEntityByName("HumanPlayer") if hum then hum:SetWalkPathByName("player_cut_path") end
trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutCreditsFadeIn
trigger.script: local vehPlayer = GetPlayerVehicle() if vehPlayer then vehPlayer:SetGamePositionOnGround(CVector(893.077, 255.493, 987.899)) vehPlayer:SetRotation(Quaternion(-0.009, -0.005, -0.000, 1.000)) end trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutCreditsCamPlayer01
trigger.script: AddCinematicMessage(2, 0) trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutCreditsCamPlayer02
trigger.script: AddCinematicMessage(3, 0) trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutCreditsCam_start_game
trigger.script: PlayCustomMusic("silence") AddCinematicMessage(77773, 0) trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: cutCreditsEnd
trigger.script:
IMPULSES = GET_GLOBAL_OBJECT "IMPULSES" IMPULSES:BindKey1("GS_CINEMATIC", "KEY_SPACE", "IM_CINEMATIC_SKIP_MSG")
RestoreAllToleranceStatus()
local hum = GetEntityByName("HumanPlayer") if hum then hum:Remove() end
TDeactivate("cutCreditsFadeIn") TDeactivate("cutCreditsCamPlayer01") TDeactivate("cutCreditsCamPlayer02") TDeactivate("cutCreditsCam_start_game")
TActivate("CloseGate1ForCredits")
SetCameraBehindPlayerVehicle()
SetVar("WatchCredits", 1)
TActivate("MessageEndGame")
trigger:Deactivate()
